name: Postmark
description: Transactional and broadcast email, message streams, templates, activity, bounces, statistics, and account administration through Postmark's REST API.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Postmark server token and optional account token, select capabilities, and let agents inspect the server, send email, or use the full supported API under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Postmark server token
credentialRequirements.helpText: The token for the exact Postmark server agents may use.

credentialRequirements.name: POSTMARK_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Postmark account token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Optional. Add only for selected account-level server, sender, or domain administration.

credentialRequirements.name: POSTMARK_SENDER_BOUNDARY
credentialRequirements.label: Sender boundary
credentialRequirements.helpText: An exact confirmed sender email or verified domain.

credentialRequirements.name: POSTMARK_MESSAGE_STREAM
credentialRequirements.label: Message stream
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact transactional or broadcast MessageStream ID agents may use.

capabilities.label: Server
capabilities.description: Read bounded metadata for the connected server.

capabilities.label: Send email
capabilities.description: Send through the bound sender and message stream.

capabilities.label: Full Postmark API
capabilities.description: Use all server-token APIs and optional account-token APIs within the connection authority.

approvalRequired.label: Send email
approvalRequired.description: Sending email requires approval in Safe mode.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Postmark API
approvalRequired.description: All other Postmark API operations require approval in Safe mode.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly; sends and all other API operations require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The agent may use every selected Postmark capability without Relay per-action approvals; token authority, ownership, sender/stream binding, secret isolation, audit evidence, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts selected Postmark tools and proxies tokens server-side.
Railway mounts selected Postmark tools and proxies tokens server-side.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer enters their own server token, optional account token, sender boundary, and message stream.

evidence.supports: Postmark uses customer-owned server and account token headers at one fixed TLS API origin and returns 401 for invalid tokens.
Single sends require a confirmed sender, allow at most 50 recipients, and have a 10 MB payload limit; batch sends permit 500 messages and 50 MB.
Server-token APIs cover server settings and return API token lists that Relay must redact.
Account-token APIs provide optional account-owner server administration authority.
